features.title: Start time and duration on every tool call
features.summary: Each tool card in the chat transcript, native or plugin-owned, root or nested, shows how long the call took and when it started ("1.2 s · 14:02:11"). While a call runs the duration counts up live. The start time reads as clock time or relative time, and the whole line can be hidden.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; show the timing line on tool cards.
How the start time reads: clock time (with the day when not today) or relative to now.

failureModes: No call time is shown while the model is still writing the arguments.
A result whose call fell outside the loaded history shows only when it ended.

If DSH stops rendering tool cards through the keyed tool-call renderer and its renderSlot dispatch, the line disappears and the browser console logs one @dshfiles/tool-meta warning; the cards themselves are untouched.

verification.testName: reads a running call from its dispatch time and a settled one from its call and result times
counts back from now in the relative format
